<available_skills>
  <skill>
    <name>swarm-skill</name>
    <description>Teaches agents how to author, install, and manage Swarm skills. Covers the SKILL.md format, frontmatter fields, trigger types, hooks, scripts, references, and the difference between local (project-scoped) and global (user-scoped) skill ins…</description>
    <location>builtin:swarm-skill/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>swarm-workflow</name>
    <description>Teaches agents how to author, validate, and run Swarm multi-agent workflows. Covers the YAML schema, group execution strategies (parallel/sequential/adversarial), DAG dependency wiring, profile/provider resolution (@current, @profile), par…</description>
    <location>builtin:swarm-workflow/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>loop</name>
    <description>Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo, defaults to 10m)</description>
    <when_to_use>When the user wants a recurring task / poll / repeat on an interval. Not for one-off tasks.</when_to_use>
    <location>builtin:loop/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>pi-harness-engineering</name>
    <description>Engineering guidance for building Pi coding-agent harness extensions, especially event contracts, hook execution, TUI-only rendering, model context boundaries, and Swarm-style hook presentation.</description>
    <location>/home/swarm/Work/Pi-Swarm/.swarm/skills/pi-harness-engineering/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
</available_skills>
